_comment: velocity m/s, gravity = projectile gravity scale. Optional: acceleration (m/s^2, negative = slows down) + acceleration_time (s, the game's ConstantAccelerationTimeout: the motor acts in the 20 ms flight substeps that start before it), max_speed (m/s, the projectile's MaxSpeed: the speed is capped at every substep, the first one too; omitted or 0 = no cap), rotation_follows_velocity (default true: the motor pushes along the path; false: along the barrel's axis at launch, the UB-32's S-5), arc low/high, aim overlay/elevation, unit deg/mil, angle_offset, min_distance, elevation_limits [min,max], bore (deg: how far above the screen centre the shot leaves in the view the weapon is aimed through; the game fires along the barrel socket Attach_Muzzle, tilted against the camera), zoom (FOV divisor of that view: a scope, an optic or the gunner's sight; omitted = ×1; a weapon whose RMB sight zooms the screen has a second '<name> · no optic' entry for its normal view, with that camera's bore and no zoom), launch_height + muzzle_forward + muzzle_up (m: the barrel pivot above the ground and the barrel socket along and above the barrel), hold_rate + hold_elevation (a barrel laid by holding a key), category, note. Sources: velocity, gravity, rocket motor, speed cap, view and the elevation limits of the direct-fire mounts read from the game files (Squad build 26005357: WeaponConfig.MuzzleVelocity; the projectile's ProjectileGravityScale, ConstantAcceleration/Timeout, MaxSpeed and bRotationFollowsVelocity; the mount's pitch limits plus the barrel socket's pitch; snapshot tests/data/game_weapons.json, written by tools/game_weapons.py); the other elevation limits, arcs and the AGS-17 hold model from in-game measurements, the official Squad wiki (squad.fandom.com) and SquadCalc (github.com/sh4rkman/SquadCalc).

MK19.note: Fire short bursts and walk the impacts onto the target; minimum arming range ~30 m. The tripod MK19 (and C16 / L134A1) fires faster: pick "MK19 · emplacement / C16 / L134A1" (or its "· no sights" entry without RMB); for the AGS-17 pick "AGS-17 · emplacement". M1117 and AAVP-7A1: the gunner's sight at ×1; the barrel and the camera are aligned (the shot leaves through the screen centre). M113, M1151 and RHIB open turrets without RMB: this entry (their camera is on the barrel's axis). For the other vehicles pick their own entry.

MK19 · PARS III RWS.note: PARS III remote turret: the gunner's sight at ×1; the shot leaves 0.95° above the screen centre (zero ~180 m).

MK19 · TAPV C16 RWS.note: TAPV C16 remote turret: the gunner's sight at ×1; the shot leaves 1.55° above the screen centre (zero ~295 m).

MK19 · M113 open turret.note: M113A3 / M113A2T open turret, aimed through the sights (RMB, no zoom): they look 1.6° below the barrel, so the shot leaves 1.6° above the screen centre (zero ~300 m). Without RMB the camera is on the barrel's axis: pick "MK19".

MK19 · M1151 / RHIB open turret.note: M1151 / RHIB open turret, aimed through the sights (RMB, no zoom): they look 1.72° below the barrel, so the shot leaves 1.72° above the screen centre (zero ~325 m). Without RMB the camera is on the barrel's axis: pick "MK19".

MK19 · emplacement / C16 / L134A1.note: Tripod MK19, C16 and L134A1: 235 m/s against 230 m/s on vehicles. Aimed through the sights (RMB, no zoom), which look 1.674° below the barrel: the shot leaves 1.674° above the screen centre (zero ~330 m). Without RMB pick "MK19 · emplacement / C16 / L134A1 · no sights". Fire short bursts; minimum arming range ~30 m.

MK19 · emplacement / C16 / L134A1 · no s.note: Tripod MK19, C16 and L134A1 fired from the normal view, without RMB: the camera is on the barrel's axis, so the shot leaves through the screen centre. Through the sights (RMB) pick "MK19 · emplacement / C16 / L134A1". Fire short bursts; minimum arming range ~30 m.

AGS-17 · emplacement.note: AGS-17 with the PAG-17 optic, aimed through the optic (RMB, ×2.5). High arc: W puts the barrel up, hold S for the shown time. Low arc: aim with the overlay mark, which accounts for the optic's 0.85° socket (zero ~58 m); from the normal view, without RMB, pick "AGS-17 · emplacement · no optic". Velocity 185 m/s and gravity ×1.8 come from the game files; the hold rate and the top of the mount are fitted on 67 in-game hold-time measurements (280–1930 m, 7 m RMS error), the same as the Deadline SquadCalc. The fitted top, 85.87°, is the mount's 85° limit plus this optic's 0.85°, so the fit is of the optic gun; for the open-sight gun pick "AGS-17 · iron sights emplacement". The game files give 9.00°/s (keyboard pitch ×15 × turret input ×0.6), which fits the same measurements as well (top 85.69°, 5.5 m RMS); deadline-squad/squad-ballistics#5 (D6) settles which.

AGS-17 · emplacement · no optic.note: AGS-17 with the PAG-17 optic, aimed from the normal view: no RMB, no zoom (×1). High arc: the same hold as "AGS-17 · emplacement": W puts the barrel up, hold S for the shown time. Low arc: aim with the overlay mark; the shot leaves 0.85° above the screen centre (zero ~58 m), as through the optic. Aiming through the optic (RMB, ×2.5)? Pick "AGS-17 · emplacement".

AGS-17 · iron sights emplacement.note: AGS-17 with open sights. Its barrel socket is tilted 4.5° up (the optic gun's is 0.85°), so the same mount angle shoots 3.65° higher: the top of the hold is 89.52° (the mount's 85° limit + 4.5°) and a target 33 m away can be lobbed. High arc: W puts the barrel up, hold S for the shown time. Low arc: aim with the overlay mark; the sights are zeroed at ~300 m. Velocity, gravity and the hold rate are those of "AGS-17 · emplacement"; the top is derived from the game files, not measured in game.

QLZ87.note: Tripod QLZ87 aimed through its optic (RMB, ×3). The optic is zeroed at 100 m: the shot leaves 0.774° above the screen centre. Aiming from the normal view, without RMB? Pick "QLZ87 · no optic": this mark is for the ×3 view and overshoots there. Fire short bursts; minimum arming range ~30 m.

QLZ87 · no optic.note: Tripod QLZ87 aimed from the normal view: no RMB, no zoom (×1). The barrel points 0.9° below the screen centre, so the shot leaves 0.9° under it and the view has no zero range. Aiming through the optic (RMB, ×3)? Pick "QLZ87". Fire short bursts; minimum arming range ~30 m.
